create_spaced_diffusion: create a SpacedDiffusion process that skips steps in a base GaussianDiffusion using selected timesteps
compute_space_timesteps: compute a set of strided timesteps from an original diffusion process using section counts or DDIM format
run_training_losses: run training losses through a SpacedDiffusion process with automatic timestep mapping for the wrapped model
compute_p_mean_variance: compute the posterior mean and variance for a model through SpacedDiffusion with rescaled timesteps
wrap_model_timesteps: wrap a model with _WrappedModel to map timesteps and optionally rescale them to the original step count
